newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BERGKAMP AND WRIGHT SEND CHELSEA REELING.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BERGKAMP AND WRIGHT SEND CHELSEA REELING.

text.p: Dutch international Dennis Bergkamp and England striker Ian Wright combined to help Arsenal plunge Chelsea to only their second home defeat of the English premier league season on Saturday.
Arsenal won the London derby 3-0 at Stamford Bridge to go second behind champions Manchester United, edging Liverpool into third place on goals scored.

Chelsea, beaten 4-2 by Wimbledon last October for their only previous home league defeat, fell behind after 22 minutes when Wright finished in classic style after a glorious through ball from Bergkamp.
Bergkamp also started the move for the second goal in the 53rd minute, sending Wright down the left from where he crossed for England midfielder David Platt to score from close range.
Arsenal sealed success after 80 minutes when Bergkamp completed a solo run by rounding Norwegian goalkeeper Frode Grodas to finish crisply.
Arsenal and Liverpool, who play Coventry on Sunday, are both three points behind leaders United, who face Derby later on Saturday.
